info.title: DCP-BASIC-NO-AUDIT-VERSION-001 bounded API supplement
info.description: Approved supplement to FINAL BASELINE v1.0.23. Only listed basic controls/process bindings supersede prior contracts. Historical evidence and regulated controls remain. Fully qualified schema IDs prevent Create/Update collisions without changing HTTP payload fields. DCP-EBR-TEMPLATE-NAME-001 adds required create templateName and controlled draft name editing; historical canonical content remains unchanged.

DcpProductionRelease.description: Production versionNo or If-Match remains required; both must agree when supplied. The package and published eBR current binding must match; frozen snapshot remains immutable.

DcpBookMapping.description: Read contract for retained published definitions. New create/publish rejects the historical packageVersionId alternative with BOOK_CURRENT_PROCESS_REQUIRED.

x-compatibility: Legacy basic versionNo/sourceVersionId/sourceVersionNo are ignored by adapters and excluded from new schemas. Archived published JSON is never rewritten.
